description: Fields set by environment variables are ignored. delete_stats: true deletes the stored statistics while traffic statistics are switched off; with a failed delete nothing is saved.

retention_days.description: Days the hourly statistics are kept

show_ips.description: Store and show client IP addresses

unique_visitors.description: Count unique visitors with keyed IP hashes; turning it off deletes them

visitors_cap.description: Distinct visitors counted per host and day; beyond it new visitors are not counted and the day is marked as capped

traffic_missing_paths.description: Track missing pages: count the paths of 404 and 410 responses of proxy and redirection hosts (up to 500 per domain name and day); turning it off deletes them

delete_stats.description: Also delete all stored statistics (counts, top lists, missing pages, IPs, visitor hashes). Only allowed together with traffic_enabled switching from true to false; refused with 400 otherwise
